intro.text: A singer, also called Dah, who guards Navani in stormform during the occupation of Urithiru.

items.text: Before the Everstorm, Mizthla was a parshman whose Alethi masters called him by the glyph Dah. Freed, he took the name Mizthla and came to serve Raboniel in Urithiru. He was sometimes set to guard Navani, who found him grumpy, though he told her a little of his life.

Raboniel and Navani called him in for an experiment: stormform lightning could flip a magnet's polarity, and they wanted to try it on Voidlight gems. Having melted the fabrial's coils last time, he waited for them to leave before channelling a small charge into it and calling them back.
